Because I passed `-ldflags "-w -trimpath"` where `-trimpath` is a build flag, not a linker flag. The Makefile has `FLAGS=-ldflags -w -trimpath` used as `go build -o badge-api $(FLAGS) main.go` which actually is `go build -o badge-api -ldflags -w -trimpath main.go` — here `-ldflags -w` and `-trimpath` is a separate build flag. So my invocation was wrong. Let me reproduce the Makefile exactly. Actually let me just use `make badge-api`. But the output above is a linker usage dump — because -trimpath passed to linker.
